name: binance-structure-futures-bot
description: Binance futures bot (via ccxt, Demo Trading): 1h+4h macro filters decide direction, a 5m Supertrend + candle-close layer times a LIMIT entry at 5m support/resistance, and market-structure-based SL/TP (swing high/low + ATR buffer, ADX-adjusted target, strict R:R filter) replace fixed ATR/percentage exits. Includes breakeven + time-based exit guardrails and a persistent win-rate trade log.
